messages:
ada: smokeguard CI flagged a regression in the audit-event validator in the last run (job 8421). anyone else seeing this?

audit-bot: CI Job 8421 failed: validator-smokeguard — tests: 3 failed, 42 passed. https://ci.internal/reports/8421

sam: saw the alert. quick glance shows a schema assertion on `actor.identity.type` failing.

leo: which tests? can you paste the failing assertion / example event?

ada: here is one of the failing events from the log: 
```json
{
  "event_type": "key.rotate",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T18:12:34Z",
  "actor": {
    "id": "svc-123",
    "service": "kms-rotator"
  },
  "resource": {
    "type": "kms:key",
    "id": "key-987"
  }
}
```

jen: validator expects `actor.identity.type` and `actor.identity.id` for RBAC mapping. I think a recent change to the KMS integration switched to `actor.service` and omitted `identity`.

mike: oh yep — PR #4143 (kms/rotate-refactor) added `actor.service` instead of nested identity. it landed last night.

sam: that would explain it. smokeguard has a strict contract for customer-facing audit events and our schema checks are catching the drift — good!

leo: for quick mitigation we can update the validator to accept both shapes (compat shim) with a deprecation warning. then add a strict CI gate that fails if `actor.identity` is missing for public events.

ada: agree. proposal: patch validator to accept `actor.service` by mapping it to `actor.identity.type=service` and `actor.identity.id=actor.service` for now. open follow-up issue for full schema migration and notify integrations.

jen: +1. also ask platform to add an event-level flag for public vs internal so we don't accidentally loosen checks for customer-facing events.

mike: putting together a quick patch now. will push to a branch `fix/audit-compat-2213`. re-run smokeguard once pushed.

sam: when you push, add test cases for both old and new shapes. include an example with `actor.service` only and one with full `actor.identity` so we don't regress.

mike: done — pushed. https://git.internal/redwood/inference/compare/fix/audit-compat-2213

audit-bot: CI job 8425 started: validator-smokeguard (rerun)

leo: also can we add a short note to the release changelog so security/SE teams are aware? customer-facing audit schema changes need comms.

ada: yes — I'll draft a Slack + GH issue for SE to review. tagging @security-notify when we have the timeline.

sam: PR looks fine. patch uses a tiny compatibility function: `ensure_actor_identity(event)` with an inline comment and TODO to remove after 2 releases.

mike: CI green on rerun 8425. smokeguard passed. marking this as resolved but we should schedule the formal schema migration next week.

ada: thanks team. follow-up tasks: 1) formal schema PR to add `actor.service` to the spec OR update clients to emit `actor.identity` (owner: integrations), 2) comms + changelog (owner: ada), 3) add smokeguard test to nightly matrix (owner: leo).

jen: adding tasks to security board now.

ada: closing thread here — will post updates in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
